fact: NBS and OCGS Zanzibar published the 2024 Updated Statistical Business Register report, compiled from Tanzania Revenue Authority and Zanzibar Revenue Authority tax records plus establishment surveys, giving 257,405 establishments in 2024 against 219,371 in 2023 (+17.3%); figures cover 2024, release date taken from the source's published date as the report itself is dated September 2025.

fact: NBS and the Zanzibar Office of the Chief Government Statistician, under TSMP II (2022/23-2026/27), developed the first manual for integrating administrative data into official statistics, after assessing how sector bodies produce administrative data; the manual states that administrative data is not yet used for official statistics because of quality gaps, and the document carries no date, so its 2024 year is the published date and the as_of.
system: Manual for Strengthening and Integrating Administrative Data into National Official Statistics of Tanzania (2024)

system: Annual Health Statistical Tables and Figures 2024
